senses.definition: n.pr.m. (God has loved, cf. Sab. ודדאל DHMZMG 1883, 15; v. also יְדִידְיָה) one of the elders Nu 11:26, 27; prob. = אֱלִידָד Nu 34:21 where called a prince of Benjamin.—On n.pr. with אֵל cf. those with אָב & אָח, & especially Nöl.c., v. p. 42, & (Sab.) DHMEpigr. Denkm.88.
